subject: Conclude-to-Commit: evaluation exit criteria & handoff checklist
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rivas <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Conclude-to-Commit: evaluation exit criteria & handoff checklist

Elena,

Thanks for the thoughtful trial — excellent engagement from your engineering and clinical teams.
I sketched a short 'conclude-to-commit' plan so we can close the MAP cleanly next two weeks.
High level exit gates we're proposing:

- Performance (primary): 95th pctl latency <= 250ms for 512-token requests under trial throughput (baseline: 20 req/s).
- Quality: ≥92% clinical-concordance on the annotated prompt set (see evaluation-runbook.xlsx).
- Cost/ops: projected per-1M-token cost under reserved profile <= $X (we'll share model selection options).
- Security & compliance: SOC2 evidence uploaded + completed data-retention plan (legal signoff).
- Reliability: sustained error-rate < 0.5% during 72-hour soak.

Acceptance tests (owners):
1) Latency soak — Karthik (redwood) to run load harness and record metrics.
2) Concordance sweep — Marissa to coordinate labeled prompts from NovaMed clinical SME.
3) Failover & rollback — Vivek/infra to demonstrate fallback to smaller quantized variant.
4) Audit/proof — Security pack and retention policy for legal review.

Target timeline: kickoff verification on Sep 1; full evidence package by Sep 8; SOW signature by Sep 10.
Attached: MAP_v2.pdf (mutual action plan summary) and evaluation-runbook.xlsx (test cases).

Please confirm the timeline and any missing owners on your side — I copied Marissa to own the concordance test coordination.

Thanks,

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rivas <elena@novamed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conclude-to-Commit: evaluation exit criteria & handoff checklist

Vivek —

Thanks for mapping this out so clearly. The timeline looks plausible; quick notes from our side:

- Clinical concordance owner will be Dr. Priya Shah (cc'd here: priya.shah@novamed.com). I'll loop her into the test labeling but please expect some back-and-forth on edge cases.
- Procurement wants the SOW draft and an estimated 3-month committed cost to evaluate finance impact (they're now cc'd).
- Legal asks for the retention language up front; can you provide the data-retention appendix by Sep 3?

Assuming those items are addressed we can hit your Sep 10 SOW target.

Best,

Elena
Elena Rivas
Director, Clinical AI Programs
NovaMed
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conclude-to-Commit: evaluation exit criteria & handoff checklist

Vivek — quick technical clarifications before we commit test owners/timeslots:

- Latency soak: I propose running two profiles — 20 req/s for 72h (trial baseline) and a 50 req/s stress run for 2h. The kernel selection for large model will be the baseline; fallback to 4-bit quantized variant if memory pressure occurs.
- Concordance sweep: What's the minimum sample size Dr. Shah expects? I'll need that to size the labeling sprint. Marissa — can you confirm availability to ingest labeled sets into our eval harness?
- For the SOC2 evidence: security will upload the pack to the shared Drive folder; I'll reference it in the runbook.

Attachments: sow-draft.docx (local stub)

Onwards — I'll reserve engineering hours Sep 1–4 for the soak.

—Karthik
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rivas <elena@novamed.com>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Novamed Legal <legal@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T15:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conclude-to-Commit: evaluation exit criteria & handoff checklist

Elena — all great points. Confirming actions & owners:

- Marissa will coordinate with Dr. Shah for labeling cadence and will report sample-size recommendations by Sep 2.
- Karthik will run the two-run latency profile; infra notes and soak metrics will be uploaded to the Drive folder during Sep 1–4.
- Security will provide the data-retention appendix and SOC2 evidence by Sep 3 for legal review.
- I will send the SOW draft with a 3-month committed-cost appendix by EOD Sep 2 and share a DocuSign link for Novamed review.

Next steps for procurement/legal: review the sow-draft.docx and the Drive link; if anything blocks you, flag it directly and we'll adjust.

Thanks everyone — let's aim to close the MAP on Sep 10.

Best,

Vivek
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_v2.pdf; evaluation-runbook.xlsx; sow-draft.docx
